prompt: You want to buy an in-game item the moment you see it advertised. Which rule is most likely to help you spend wisely?

options.text: Buy it instantly, before the offer ends
Ask a friend to buy it for you instead
Borrow the money so you do not miss out
Wait 24 hours, then check whether you still want it and what else that money would have to give up

explanation: A short wait separates an impulse from a genuine want, and weighing what the money would otherwise buy makes the trade-off visible before you spend, not after.
